title: Geizhals Price Comparison Search Scraper
description: Search Geizhals for products with manufacturer, GTIN, rating summaries, best-price ranges, and product links. Batch keywords across German and European markets.

batch.title: Product searches
batch.description: Product keywords to search across Geizhals markets.
batch.valueDescription: keyword used for this Geizhals search.

schema.description: Market code: de, at, eu, pl, or uk. Defaults to de.
Response language: de or en. Defaults to de.
Results per page, between 1 and 1000. Defaults to 10.
Optional sort key as used by Geizhals (e.g. price). Defaults to relevance.
Optional Geizhals category id to constrain results.
Optional manufacturer id to constrain results.

test_reviews.title: Northstar Aurora 1 TB Smartphone
test_reviews.abstract: Customers praise the clear product details and responsive service.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Search Geizhals by keyword for manufacturers, GTINs, ratings, and best prices. Batch queries to compare products across German and European markets.
storeCopy.intro: Search Geizhals by product keyword and collect manufacturer names, product IDs, GTINs, price summaries, and rating information. Choose a market and page through matching products.
useCases: Shopping researchers can compare product variants and price ranges across Geizhals markets.
Retail teams can track manufacturers, GTINs, and product coverage by keyword.
Buyers can export product IDs and links for a shortlist of hardware or electronics.
howToUse: Add one product keyword to `queries` for each search.
Choose a market and language, then optionally set category or manufacturer filters.
Set `maxPages` and `maxResults` before exporting product matches.

faqs.question: Which markets can I search?
faqs.answer: The source accepts de, at, eu, pl, and uk market codes. Results and currency presentation follow the selected market.
